title: How to install npm
content: To install npm (Node Package Manager), you need to install Node.js. Here are the steps to install npm: 1. Visit the official Node.js website at https://nodejs.org. 2. On the homepage, you'll find the download section. Node.js provides pre-built installers for various operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux). Choose the appropriate installer for your operating system and click on the download button. 3. Once the installer is downloaded, run it on your computer. The installation process will guide you through the setup. 4. During the installation, you'll be prompted to choose various options. By default, npm is included in the Node.js installation, so you don't need to select any additional options. 5. Follow the instructions provided by the installer to complete the installation process. 6. After the installation is finished, open a command prompt or terminal window and verify that Node.js and npm are installed correctly by running the following commands: ```bash node -v npm -v ``` These commands will display the versions of Node.js and npm installed on your system if the installation was successful. Congratulations! You have now installed npm on your computer. You can use npm to manage packages and dependencies for your Node.js projects.
